item.title: 131 Student Musicians Celebrate 50th Anniversary of Schuylkill County Band Festival
item.description: The Schuylkill County Band celebrated a historic milestone this past weekend as students, educators, and community members gathered to mark the organization’s 50th anniversary with a special golden jubilee concert. The event honored the band’s rich musical legacy while highlighting the future of music education in the county. item.title: Phone Scam Leads to $2,500 Theft in Schuylkill County's North Union Township
item.description: Pennsylvania State Police are investigating a theft by deception case after a Schuylkill County woman was scammed out of $2,500 earlier this week. Accordng to a public information release from the Pennsylvania State Police at Frackville, the incident occurred on March 3, 2026, around 2:40 p.m. in North Union Township. Troopers said a 55-year-old woman from Nuremberg reported receiving a phone call from an unknown individual who claimed to be associated with the Philadelphia Federal Credit Union.
